newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Czech Nova Hut seen buying into Slovenia's Alpos.
newsitem.headline: Czech Nova Hut seen buying into Slovenia's Alpos.

text.p: Slovenia's unlisted metal product maker Alpos said on Wednesday Czech steel maker Nova Hut Ostrava was expected to invest $8.7 million for a 38 percent equity stake in Alpos.
"We signed an agreement with our Czech partner on Friday and we expect the deal to be approved by Alpos shareholders in the middle of June," Alpos deputy director Joze Artnak told Reuters.
He said the company needed fresh capital in order to repay unfavourable loans and to boost investment, adding that for the past 20 years Nova Hut had been one of Alpos's main suppliers of steel.

"We expect to end 1997 with a profit of 115 million tolars if the capital injection is approved. If that does not happen, we would have a loss of about 212 million tolars on account of expensive interest rates on past loans," Artnak said.
The company ended 1996 with a profit of 13.6 million tolars, after a loss of 140.9 million in 1995.
Artnak said Alpos was expected to increase sales to $40.7 million in 1997 from $34.9 million last year. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 157.0 Slovenian Tolars)
